writeup: TIC 229490432 is an eclipsing binary star system newly discovered in TESS data that had escaped detection in six existing variable-star catalogs. The system shows a primary eclipse with a depth of 1.59 percent and an orbital period of 2.328704 days. The initial analysis detected a signal with a strength of 325.9, confirmed by difference-imaging techniques that pinpointed the star's location to within 3.3 arcseconds. However, careful examination of eclipse patterns revealed that successive eclipses vary significantly in depth, indicating the true period is double the first measurement. No secondary eclipse was detected in the available data. This discovery adds a previously unknown eclipsing binary to our catalog of stellar systems.
